test_fallback_chain_initialization: test the AIAgent fallback chain initialization with no fallback, single dict, list of providers, and invalid entries
test_fallback_chain_advancement: test the AIAgent fallback chain advancement through multiple providers on activation
test_invalid_entries_filtered: test that invalid fallback provider entries are filtered from the chain
test_provider_skip_on_failure: test that the fallback chain skips unconfigured or failing providers to the next in the list
test_fallback_exhaustion: test that the fallback chain returns false when all providers are exhausted
